{{Top}}
'''Rogue Eight''' was the callsign used by certain fighter pilots of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].

The pilots who have used the callsign include:
*[[Vekozev Kabir]] ([[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]])<ref name="SWK">[[Star Wars Kids (1997)|''Star Wars Kids'' (1997)]]</ref>
*[[Avan Beruss]] ([[4 ABY/Legends|4]]&ndash;[[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]])<ref name="XWRS:M">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 28|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 28]]</ref><ref name="XWRS:MR">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 35|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 35]]</ref>
*[[Erisi Dlarit]] ([[6 ABY/Legends|6.5 ABY]])<ref name="XW:RS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>
*[[Nawara Ven]] ([[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]])<ref name="XW:TBW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>
*[[Koobis Nu]] (7 ABY)<ref name="XW:SC">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref>
*[[Khe-Jeen Slee]] ([[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]])<ref name="XW:IR">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref>
*[[Leth Liav]] ([[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]])<ref name="NJO:EL">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>
